slumpGraphs._comment: Per-player game-by-game diff history, for the ranking scene's slump graph (Version 2+). Leave a player's entry null/absent when real simulator output isn't available yet -- the renderer falls back to the simple rank/value display instead of fabricating a graph. Shape when available: rank1: [{ "game": 0, "diff": 0 }, { "game": 500, "diff": 1200 }, ...] sampled at regular game intervals up to gamesPerPlayer.
